decision.reasoning_trace: The search for a backpack resulted in a mix of actual backpacks and miscellaneous camping gear. Among the backpack options, I narrowed the consideration set to the KAILAS 28L for its lightweight design, the Maxpedition for high-end EDC durability, the QT&QY 45L for tactical utility, the N NEVO RHINO for hydration-focused activities, and the High Sierra 70L for heavy-duty hiking. I ultimately selected the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack because it offers an exceptional balance of high customer satisfaction (4.7 rating with over 6,000 reviews) and affordability ($39.99), making it the most value-driven purchase in the set.
